name: ruflo
description: The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
one_liner: A control system that lets you run many AI coding agents at once, coordinating them like a small team instead of one assistant working alone.
buyer: A dev-tools agency or technical founder running large codebase migrations who wants to parallelize AI agent work instead of babysitting one assistant at a time.
business_use_cases: An agency doing large legacy-code migrations deploys a swarm of agents to work on different modules simultaneously, billing clients for the faster turnaround.
A startup building its own AI dev-tool product uses this as the orchestration backbone instead of building agent coordination from scratch.
A technical consultant offers an 'AI dev team as a service' to small businesses, using the harness to simulate a multi-person engineering team for roughly the cost of one developer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI engineering team' monthly retainers to small businesses: a swarm of agents building and maintaining their app.
Package a pre-tuned swarm configuration for a specific repetitive task, such as test-writing or documentation generation, and sell it as a one-off recipe.

steal_this: Spin up a 3-agent swarm against a real backlog of small tickets this weekend and track how much faster it clears the backlog versus a single agent.
